inputs.input: Build a polished responsive login and signup website with distinct account creation and sign-in modes, durable user accounts, server-validated sessions that survive refresh, session-revoking sign out, accessible keyboard-friendly forms, and useful validation and authentication errors
primaryWorkflows: A new visitor creates an account and remains signed in after refresh.
A returning user signs in, refreshes successfully, then signs out and loses access.
A user corrects validation or authentication errors through keyboard-friendly forms.
requiredSurfaces: A person can switch between distinct sign-in and account-creation modes using keyboard and pointer input.
Submitting valid sign-up details creates a durable user account and reaches an authenticated state.
Submitting valid credentials authenticates the existing account and reaches an authenticated state.
Invalid, incomplete, and incorrect credentials produce useful accessible validation or authentication errors.
An authenticated session remains valid after a page refresh.
Signing out revokes the active session and leaves the person unauthenticated after refresh.
All form controls support logical keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, and announced errors.
